The RxNXT promise

A complete digital prescription, in under 30 seconds.

From patient selection to a printable, legible prescription — watch the full workflow your doctors run every day.

  1. 1
    Select patient from live queue

    The doctor taps the next patient. The consultation context loads instantly — no file hunting, no manual lookup.

  2. 2
    Build the prescription

    Search medicines, set dosage and duration, add notes. RxNXT keeps every field one tap away with smart defaults.

  3. 3
    Save & print

    One click produces a clean, legible digital prescription — ready to print or share. The queue advances automatically.
